result.detail: 로컬 WASM OCR 원문이에요. 오인식 가능성이 있어요. 작업 사실로 자동 확정하지 않아요.

limitations: One public printed-form PNG only, no accuracy benchmark or handwriting validation
Table layout and some Korean characters are misrecognized; OCR text is raw evidence, never automatic confirmation of farm work
JPEG, WebP and HEIC paths not live-tested; unsupported decode preserves original and reports failure
